description: The chart-only long/short position drawing tool. Draw an entry, stop and target box immediately when those price levels are known. It needs no account equity or risk percentage, performs no position sizing and places no order. Use position_plan_on_chart instead only when the user also wants quantity and risk calculations. Changes the chart you are building; call chart_link when you are done so the person can open it.

barsWide.description: Width when timestamps are omitted. Default 20 bars.

name: position_draw_on_chart
